description: Blueprint device budgets for quality presets and soft auto-downgrade/upgrade. Finish 5.0 Phase 27 raises harbor LRU to 4 and denser-scene presenter caps for 12 harbors.

android.label: Android mid-tier
android.resolutionNote: Native device resolution; Filament MSAA only on high

web.label: Web mid desktop @1080p
web.resolutionNote: Medium caps DPR ≤1.5 and draws at most 1080 CSS px tall; high ≤2× DPR

low.web: 1× DPR, no shadows, crowd≤3, fly≤4, burst≤2
low.android: no shadows, no MSAA, crowd≤3, fly≤4, burst≤2

medium.web: ≤1.5× DPR (≤1080 CSS tall), 1024 shadows, crowd≤6, fly≤10, burst≤5
medium.android: shadows on, no MSAA, crowd≤6, fly≤10, burst≤5

high.web: ≤2× DPR, 2048 soft shadows, crowd≤10, fly full pool, burst full pool
high.android: shadows + 4× MSAA, crowd≤10, fly full pool, burst full pool

autoUpgrade.note: Finish 5.0 Phase 27 — recover quality after sustained under-budget frames without exceeding player preset (12-harbor travel).
